_note: Single-column layout — fields map top to bottom:
┌── HEADER (auto: category color + name) ──────┐
│  [icon]          ← entity, icon               │
│  [icon]  [icon]  ← dual only (icon + icon2)   │
│  [heading]       ← heading                    │
│  [stat]          ← stat                       │
│  [prog_label]    ← progression only           │
│  [age table]     ← progression only (ages)    │
│  [who] [description] ← entity + description   │
type:        value | progression | dual | multi | desc | hidden
heading:     Big bold text — '+20%', 'FREE', 'CAN', 'Building Damage'
stat:        Smaller label below heading — 'HP', 'Cost', 'Work Rate'
description: Bottom label (who/what is affected) — 'Shepherds', 'Infantry'
entity:      Unit/building key — drives icon, small who-icon, default description
entity2:     Second entity for 'dual' cards (shown side-by-side with entity)
icon:        Filename in /static/icons/units/ — overrides main image only
icon2:       Filename for second image in 'dual'
prog_label:  Small label above the age table (progression only)
ages:        [{age, value}] — age: dark|feudal|castle|imperial; Roman numerals auto
lines:       ['...','...'] — desc card lines (auto-split on ; if omitted)
hidden:      true → card not rendered
_label:      Human note, ignored by parser — documents which bonus this is
Tokens in any string field: [food][wood][gold][stone][pop] → inline resource icons
Omitted fields fall back to auto-parse.
